description: Writes translations for one language, the same as typing on the canvas in that language. Saved at once, like every edit in Xodia; pushing to Git and publishing stay the user's. entries: page texts, each { text, value } with text exactly as get_translations gave it and value the translation ("" removes one); never put CMS item text here, it is translated with collection and items. collection with items: each item's translatable fields, its publish state in this language and its translated slug, written to the item's translation file; shared fields (dates, prices, images, references) are refused because they are the same in every language. Keep every numbered tag (<0>...</0>, <1/>) around the words it formats and every {0} {1} number placeholder exactly as in the text; translate the words between them. Translate for a website: natural wording, the brand and product names as they are, the site's tone. Each entry and item gets its own result (set, removed, unchanged or failed with why): fix and send only the failed ones again. Translate only when the user asks for it (a Translate with your AI request, or their own words); never on your own while building or editing. Languages past the site's allowance are refused (plan_limit).

branch.description: Optional branch; default the branch the workspace has open

collection.description: With items: the collection the items are in

entries.description: Page texts (not CMS text), up to 100 a call

text.description: The default-language text exactly as get_translations gave it, numbered tags and {0} placeholders included

value.description: The translation, with the same numbered tags and {n} placeholders. "" removes the translation

items.description: CMS item translations, up to 25 a call

fields.description: Translatable field id to its translation: text fields a string (rich text as Markdown), image {"alt": "..."}, multiImage [{"alt": "..."}] in the same order. null or "" removes one

item.description: The item's slug (its id in the default language)

slug.description: The item's address in this language (/<code>/<urlFolder>/<slug>); null goes back to the default slug

status.description: This language's publish state for the item. New translations are drafts unless you send published

locale.description: A language code from list_locales (not the default language)

name: set_translations
title: Set translations
